highlights: Net income attributable to ONEOK includes a one-time noncash income tax benefit of $336 million resulting from the ONEOK, Inc. reorganization related to the minority equity transaction.
In October 2026, ONEOK declared a quarterly dividend of $1.07 per share, or $4.28 per share annualized.
The three and nine months ended Sept. 30, 2025, included corporate net gains on extinguishment of debt of $22 million and $58 million, respectively, in connection with open market repurchases.

quotes.text: Higher Permian Basin volumes and the continued execution by our employees to integrate our systems contributed to ONEOK’s third-quarter results.

As we look to 2027, we expect meaningful earnings growth from our Brazos Permian Midland Basin assets, recently completed and advancing growth projects and continued commercial optimization across our systems.
